reasons: The core question answer (Hyderabad) is correct according to reference.

The 3D visuals rely on a generic avatar walking next to an unlabelled India map silhouette with a generic building icon, failing to visually explain defense incubators or pinpoint Hyderabad accurately on the map.
On-screen Hindi text is clear, legible, and properly rendered without overlapping or clipping.
Audio narration is well-timed with clear Hindi pronunciation.
The question prompt allows a full 2-second countdown before revealing the correct answer.

scene_evidence.observation: Displays the question frame asking which city will host India's first defense incubator with options A (Hyderabad) and B (Bengaluru).
A 2-second countdown timer runs with the prompt asking the viewer to comment option A or B.
Reveals the correct answer as Hyderabad ('सही उत्तर है: हैदराबाद') while a 3D avatar walks beside a map outline.
Explains that India's first defense incubator/missile development center will be set up in Hyderabad, showing a generic pillar building icon popping up.
Memory test prompt 'अब बिना देखे बताइए' appears as the character walks along the map frame.
Final revision card frame displays 'याद रखें: हैदराबाद' cleanly on screen.
